guard: Stop further epochs after either empirical or exact KL exceeds threshold; last completed epoch may overshoot, no rollback and no claimed hard KL bound.
reason: The fixed-context low-dimensional actor permits exact KL; avoid relying on an eight-sample approximation for update monitoring.
